2116614948071539134.en_summary: US corporate debt issuance is skyrocketing: US investment-grade corporate bond sales are expected to rise +$37 billion YoY in November, or +27%, to $175 billion, the highest for any November on record. This would mark a +$76 billion, or +77%, increase from November 2024 level. To put this into perspective, the 5-year average before 2025 was $104 billion. By comparison, US investment-grade bond issuance stood at ~$100 billion in October. As a result, US investment-grade bond sales have risen to a record $1.76 trillion YTD, already surpassing the full-year 2025 total of $1.75 trillion. Meanwhile, over $300 billion in AI-related corporate bonds have been issued in global investment-grade markets so far in 2026, almost 3 times the total for all of 2025. AI spending is fueling an unprecedented wave of corporate borrowing.
2116614948071539134.zh_summary: 美國企業債務發行正在飆升：美國投資級企業債券銷售預計在11月同比上升370億美元，或+27%，至1750億美元，為任何11月的最高紀錄。這將標誌著較2024年11月水平增加760億美元，或+77%。相比之下，2025年前5年平均為1040億美元。相較而言，美國投資級債券發行在10月約為1000億美元。結果，美國投資級債券銷售已升至年初至今紀錄的1.76萬億美元，已超過2025年全年總額1.75萬億美元。與此同時，2026年至今全球投資級市場已發行超過3000億美元的人工智能相關企業債券，幾乎是2025年全年總額的3倍。人工智能支出正在推動前所未有的企業借貸浪潮。
